ev.q: During July–December 2020, 10.0% of adults aged ≥18 years received care at home from a friend or family member in the past 12 months.
Women were more likely than men to receive care among those aged ≥18 years (11.5% and 8.5%, respectively)
10.0% of adults aged ≥18 years received care at home from a friend or family member in the past 12 months.
Women were more likely than men to receive care among those aged ≥18 years (11.5% and 8.5%, respectively)
Among both men and women, the percentage of adults who received care in the past 12 months increased with age.
Estimates are based on household interviews of a sample of the civilian, noninstitutionalized U.S. population.
based on data from National Health Interview Survey
